messages:
Sam: FYI - we're seeing a tokenization regression in eu-west1 after rolling model-serving:2.3.2. Error spike ~5% on production traffic. Requesting expedited hotfix: pin to model-serving:2.3.1 and a fast canary with peelback override. Need 2 approvals (product + oncall) to skip the usual 30m canary window.

deploy-bot: [deploy plan created] id=dp-1954326789, target=eu-west1, action=pin, image=model-serving:2.3.1, canary=10% -> 100%, rollback_on_errors=5%+ tokenization-regression, timeout=30m.

Maria: Can you paste the minimal release notes and rollback criteria? Also what's the blast radius if we go straight to 100%?

Sam: Short notes below. Blast radius low: only EU region routing uses this variant; global fallback exists. Rollback criteria: tokenization error rate >2x baseline for 10m OR 5% absolute increase sustained for 5m.

Sam: Release notes:
- revert tokenizer patch that caused token-splitting in edge cases
- pinned tokenizer weight file to v2026-01
- no schema changes

Raj: Oncall here. I'm +1 for expedited canary but want an automated peelback if errors exceed threshold. Can opsbot post health checks?

opsbot: Running quick canary health check now against staging-sim:
```
HTTP 200 /v1/health
avg_latency_ms: 22
tokenization_error_rate: 0.2% (staging)
```
Canary probe script: `curl -sS https://eu-west1-canary.internal/health | jq .`

Lina: Product agrees to expedite given customer impact. I'll approve conditional on: (1) pinned image, (2) immediate rollback criteria configured, (3) support notif. Lina: APPROVED :white_check_mark:

Sam: Noted. Maria, Raj, can we get final oncall + eng-sre?

Maria: Eng-sre approves bypassing the long window for a fast 10% canary -> 30m monitor -> 100% unless peelback triggers. Maria: APPROVED :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: ACTION: starting canary rollout to 10% in eu-west1. Plan id=dp-1954326789. Will post progress and health checks every 2 minutes.

opsbot: Canary health logs (first 4m):
- t=00:02 tokenization_error_rate: 0.6%
- t=00:04 tokenization_error_rate: 0.7%
- avg_latency stable under 40ms

Sam: Error is slightly above baseline but under rollback. Hold and observe 6 more minutes.

Raj: I'm watching logs and traces, no spike in customer-facing errors. If tokenization_error_rate breaches 2x baseline or >5% absolute, I will trigger rollback.

Sam: After 12m canary the metrics look steady. Maria, please post support note to EU customers affected and enable feature flag fallback for risk share.

Maria: Support ping done, note id #SUP-4309. Also alerted account execs for top five customers in EU.

deploy-bot: Canary complete. Promoting to 100% now per plan dp-1954326789.

opsbot: Post-deploy checks (2m): tokenization_error_rate: 0.9% (within target), latencies nominal.

Sam: Thanks all. Keeping this thread open for 30m to watch for regressions. If anything odd, @Raj will initiate rollback.

Raj: Acknowledge. Will call rollback if thresholds crossed.

Lina: Thanks team. Please include this in release notes and follow-up postmortem if any customer impact surfaces.

Sam: Filed follow-up ticket: RE-195432 - doc hotfix timeline + post-deploy checklist. Closing approvals thread once 30m observation completes.
